title: ds.evidence_ref.v0.1
description: Draft, format-neutral reference to a verifiable evidence object. Internal draft pending Keith approval; not an adopted standard. SAR is one supported evidence_type, not a required format. See README.md for full spec, boundary requirements, and consumer guidance.

ref_id.description: Stable local identifier for this evidence reference inside the parent artifact.

evidence_type.description: Format/type of the referenced evidence. Not restricted to SAR; any verifiable evidence type may be used.

uri.description: URI/URL where the evidence object can be retrieved, if available. May be omitted only if digest or embedded_ref is present.

digest.description: Content digest of the referenced evidence object, if known. Algorithm prefix required, e.g. sha256:...

digest_canonicalization.description: Canonicalization rule used to compute digest, if applicable.

embedded_ref.description: Inline evidence object or excerpt, used when no external uri/digest locator applies (e.g. a small embedded artifact). Opaque to this schema.

issuer.description: Optional issuer or system that produced the evidence. Must not be treated as authority by itself.

subject.description: Optional subject/claim/outcome this evidence supports. Keep short and claim-bounded.

verification.description: Verification hints, not verification results. Does not itself assert PASS/FAIL.

boundary.description: Human-readable boundary statement: what this evidence reference does and does not prove. Required on every object. Must not claim legal/payment finality for payment- or settlement-related evidence unless separately proven.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the evidence reference object was created, if known.

relation.description: How the evidence relates to the parent artifact.

retrieved_at.description: Recommended. When the referenced evidence was last fetched/checked.

source_commit.description: Recommended. Commit hash for provenance, when the evidence lives in a git-tracked artifact.

profile.description: Recommended. Named sub-profile of evidence_type, e.g. 'sar-402' under evidence_type 'sar'.

receipt_id.description: Recommended. Meaningful only when evidence_type is receipt-shaped; absent/ignored otherwise.

parent_artifact_id.description: Recommended. Identifier of the artifact this evidence ref is embedded in.

notes.description: Recommended. Free-text context that doesn't fit elsewhere.
